sources.games: 410 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 46.3%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py mirana.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 9 (abilities named in fight and skills), 7.41f.

rules.name: Solar Crest
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Solar Crest: Shine on an ally: +5 armor, +60 attack speed, +15% movement speed and a 350 physical damage barrier for 7 s (16 s cooldown, 100 mana, cast range 1000); shared cooldown with Pavise. It has no effect on evasion itself. High-rank games against an evasion hero: 32% of 50 games (14% otherwise), won 56% with it against 38% without; Pavise 34% (15%).

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute (parts and consumables dropped): arcane_boots 52% (13), essence_distiller 42% (15), cyclone 43% (24), ultimate_scepter 43% (34). STRATZ pos4 (8648 games): Essence Distiller 13 min, Eul's 21 min (58%), Aghanim's Scepter 29 min (82%); pos5 the same at 12, 21, 30 min. The league build is later by 3-5 min.
